title: Uncles Oscar, Oliver and Major Giles, and Thibodeaux bands
summary: His uncles were drummers; Major played with Joe Banks's band, and they mention guitarist Adam Lombard and the family order.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
